title: Not Making Things Worse
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett reflects on how participating in the evening's service has reminded them that they enjoy doing so, and how this experience has sparked their desire to share teachings from early Buddhism with the group. They discuss the Salata Sutta, which distinguishes between two groups of people: those who have not yet understood the Buddha's teachings and those who have practiced for a long time. The key difference between these two groups is how they relate to unpleasant emotions - well-taught noble disciples experience their emotions without adding extra thoughts or reactions, allowing them to navigate difficult situations with greater ease.
